bible_refs.note: Living water promised to the Samaritan woman.

pass_a_gloss: For there is a better which Christ was promising he would give to the Samaritan woman.
pass_b_english: For there is a better water, which Christ promised he would give to the Samaritan woman (John 4:10) (John 4:14).
source_text: ἔστι γὰρ κρεῖττον ὃ τῇ Σαμαρίτιδι δώσειν ὁ Χριστὸς ἐπηγγέλλετο.]
